'''Meetra Surik's lightsaber''' was the personal weapon of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meetra Surik]], more commonly known as the Jedi Exile.

==History==
Meetra Surik constructed her Jedi lightsaber some time before the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. During the War, she would use it against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] conquering the galaxy in a number of battle such as [[Battle of Eres III|Eres III]], [[Second battle of Onderon (Mandalorian Wars)|Onderon]], [[Battle of Dxun|Dxun]], [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|Duro]] and eventually the [[Battle of Malachor V]].<ref name="KotOR II" />

After the war's end, Surik was called to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to answer for her actions during the conflict. Despite an impassioned plea, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decreed that because she had followed [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to war, she was to be [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|cast out]] of the Jedi Order. In defiance when they asked for the surrender of her lightsaber, she stabbed it into the center stone of the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]]. During the following years, the weapon was kept in the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="KotOR II" />

When the [[Jedi Civil War]] broke out, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi historian|historian]] [[Atris]] evacuated most of the Jedi historical materials, including [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and Surik's lightsaber, to the [[Telosian Jedi Academy|academy]] on [[Telos IV]] in case of an [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|attack]]. [[3951 BBY|Five years later]], Meetra Surik found Atris on Telos during her search for the [[Lost Jedi]]. The Jedi Master refused to return her the lightsaber which had become for the historian a symbol of the violence of the Mandalorian Wars corrupted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]]. But the Exile later discovered that Atris had in fact become a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Meetra Surik returned to the Academy and clashed successfully with the historian in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], allowing her to recover her first lightsaber.<ref name="KotOR II" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
During Atris' battle with the Exile, it was planned she would use the Exile's first lightsaber against her, claiming it is not hers to wield anymore. However, it was cut from the game.

The lightsaber is customizable through a discussion with [[Atton Rand]]; the player can choose to make it single or double-hilted and what color the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] was. Whatever choices the player makes, Atris will reveal the lightsaber when conversing with the Exile. Choosing not to discuss the lightsaber with Atton makes it a single-hilt with a cyan blade (coincidentally, the only color not available in the dialogue choices).<ref name="KotOR II" />
